title: ...set up your 401(k) at a new job
desc: Capture employer matching money and automate retirement compound growth.
todos: Contribute at least enough percentage to claim 100% of employer matching contribution.
Select low-cost Target Date Index Fund or broad S&P 500 index fund options.
Choose Traditional (tax-deferred) or Roth (tax-free growth) contribution type.
Enable annual auto-escalation to increase savings rate by 1% each year.
Designate primary and secondary account beneficiaries.
